import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

demands = ["Enzyme must stay\nfolded 18-24 h\nat 37 C",
           "Cells energized,\ngrowing in rich\nbroth",
           "All-or-none\nendpoint (total\ngrowth inhibition)",
           "Ceiling on enzyme\nconcentration\ntested",
           "Divalent cations\nsupplied by the\nmedium"]
assays = ["Zymogram","Turbidity","Plate lysis","MIC broth"]
# 1 = assay imposes this demand, 0 = it does not, 0.5 = partly / unknown
M = np.array([
 [0,0,0,0,0],      # zymogram: ~1 h, water, dead cells in gel, huge local enzyme, no cations added
 [0,0,0,0,0],      # turbidity: 5-10 min, buffer, washed non-growing cells, max-rate endpoint
 [1,1,0,0,0.5],    # plate lysis: overnight, live lawn, but graded endpoint and up to 100 uM local
 [1,1,1,1,1],      # MIC: all of them
])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6,3.6))
im=ax.imshow(M, cmap="YlOrRd", vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(demands))); ax.set_xticklabels(demands, fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(assays))); ax.set_yticklabels(assays, fontsize=9.5)
for i in range(M.shape[0]):
    for j in range(M.shape[1]):
        lab={0:"no",0.5:"partly",1:"yes"}[M[i,j]]
        ax.text(j,i,lab,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8.5,
                color="white" if M[i,j]>0.6 else "black")
ax.set_title("What each LysK assay demands of the enzyme\n(built from methods text of PMID 25790497, 23413880, 19047377)", fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# Evidence matrix written to provenance
ev = pd.DataFrame([
